question: Perform autofocus, measure a spectrum once, apply IPBSA baseline correction with order 5, and report the peaks found (prominence 5% of range).
criteria: PROC(args EXACT) + SET(peak ±3 cm-1) / post-hoc GT
answer_text:
The measurement and analysis were performed successfully. After performing the autofocus and acquiring a single spectrum at $(37.83, 25.24)$ with 20% laser power, I applied an IPBSA baseline correction of order 5. From the resulting corrected spectrum, 14 peaks were identified using a prominence threshold of 5% of the dynamic range.

The analysis confirmed that the core features of interest (including those in the $163$ to $2235\text{ cm}^{-1}$ range) were successfully detected. One notable feature is the presence of multiple peaks between 1100 and 1400 $\text{cm}^{-1}$, which often relate to characteristic bond vibrations or specific chemical markers in such materials.
